label: Pricing a route
subgoals: Count the steps of the route
Add the bend penalty times the bend count to the length

label: Direction-aware search
subgoals: Expand each cell into one state per incoming direction
Charge the bend cost on transitions that change direction
Run Dijkstra or A* on the expanded state graph

label: When a longer route wins
subgoals: Write both route costs as length plus vias times the via cost
Solve the inequality for the via cost
Pick the smallest integer via cost that flips the choice
